designationHistory.indexText: Leslie Canyon National Wildlife Refuge About Us What We Do Law Enforcement Laws & Regulations Contact Us Visit Us Activities Trails Rules & Policies Get Involved News Species Map About Us The 2,765-acre refuge was established in 1988 to protect two of the eight native fish species of the Río Yaqui watershed: the Yaqui chub (Gila purpurea) and the Yaqui topminnow (Poeciliopsis sonoriensis).
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
